ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ النَّبِيِّ الْأُمِّيِّ الطَّاهِرِ الْمُطَهَّرِ الزَّكِّيِّ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَسَلِّمْ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadini ‘n-Nabiyyi ‘l-Ummiyyi, al-Ṭāhiri ‘l-Muṭahhari ‘z-Zakkiyyi, Wa `alā Ālihī, wa sallim.
en: O Allah send prayers upon and salute our Master Muḥammad, the unlettered, pure, purifying and sinless and his Family!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِه ذِي الْمُعْجِزَاتِ الْبَاهِرَةِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Dhi ‘l-mu`jizāti ‘l-bāhira.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, possessor of brilliant miracles!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ ذِي الْمَنَاقِبِ الْفَاخِرَةِ.
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Dhi ‘l-manāqibi ‘l-fākhirah.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, possessor of magnificent values!
